messages:
Noah (Finance): Heads-up: Pioneer Labs INV-2026-1888 is 58 days overdue. ACH bounced this morning. Customer asked to split into two payments and requested we stop dunning emails while they finalize. Details below.
BillingBot: Automated alert: ACH return R01 for INV-2026-1888. Amount $81,250. Original due date: 2026-03-01. https://billing.redwood.ai/invoices/INV-2026-1888
Eli (Account Exec): Spoke with their Head of Finance. They had a delayed receivable. Proposal: two equal installments, first due in 7 days. They want onboarding to continue; customer willing to sign a payment-plan addendum and provide card on file.
Marta (Collections): We can offer two installments if: signed addendum, autopay enabled, and first installment clears before we pause suspension. We recommend keeping internal dunning active. Any fee waivers conditional on timely clear.
Priya (Finance Director): Approve conditional split: require card on file OR cleared ACH for first installment within 3 business days of agreement. Late fee ($2,460) may be refunded after successful first payment; not waived upfront. If first payment fails, immediate suspension + reinstatement of fees.
Legal Ops: I'll draft the short-form payment-plan addendum with autopay, default remedies, and fee-reinstatement language. Send me the exact dates and payment method once confirmed.
Eli (Account Exec): Customer proposed schedule:
``
INV-2026-1888 total $81,250
1) $40,625 due 2026-05-10 (on agreement)
2) $40,625 due 2026-06-10
Condition: refund late fee $2,460 if 1st payment posts by 2026-05-10 and autopay is active.
```
Marta (Collections): I'll prepare outbound email and attach addendum. Collections will flip the "pause external dunning" flag only after payment auth is captured. Add explicit clause: missed 1st payment -> same-day hold + fee reinstatement.
BillingBot: Note: recommended manual ACH retry blocked until authorization obtained. Current external dunning paused only after Collections flag.
Noah (Finance): Please CC finance on outbound. Once first payment clears I'll update AR aging and cash forecast and process any conditional fee refund.
Eli (Account Exec): Call scheduled 5/8 at 9am PT to secure card auth and e-sign. I'll post signed addendum here after. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
